Outside pull requests and code contributions are not accepted. This template
is for the maintainer and explicitly invited collaborators only. Use Issues
for bug reports, without patches or proposed code changes.

## What changes

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the related issue, if any.

## Validation

List checks actually run and their results. Include device, OS, model, and
source/APK version for speech or performance results. State remaining limits.

## Review notes

Include native screenshots for UI changes, with enlarged text when relevant.
Explain settings/history compatibility, dependency, privacy, or signing impact.
Name the parent PR if this change is stacked.

Keep private recordings, transcripts, dictionaries, and credentials out of the PR.
